name: @apocky/apocrypha-contributor-node
description: Opt-in, resource-capped Apocrypha contributor node with signed live transport.

scripts.ensure:candidate-dist: node --input-type=module -e "import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'; mkdirSync('candidate-dist', { recursive: true })"
scripts.pack:candidate: npm run build && npm run ensure:candidate-dist && npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination candidate-dist
scripts.release:candidate: npm run pack:candidate && node scripts/release-artifacts.mjs --input . --out candidate-dist
